meta.name: topic-monitor
meta.description: Monitor topics of interest and proactively alert when important developments occur. Use when user wants automated monitoring of specific subjects (e.g., product releases, price changes, news topics, technology updates). Supports scheduled web searches, AI-powered importance scoring, smart alerts vs weekly digests, and memory-aware contextual summaries.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动监控关注话题并主动推送重要动态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动跟踪特定话题的最新进展并接收智能提醒。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically monitor topics of interest and proactively alert on important updates.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically track specific subjects and receive smart alerts on important developments.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动监控你指定的主题（如产品发布、价格变动、新闻话题、技术更新），按设定的频率搜索网络，用 AI 判断重要性，然后通过即时提醒或每周摘要通知你。
howto.when: 当你要求监控某个主题，并完成交互式设置向导（运行 setup.py）或手动配置 config.json 后，Claude 会按你设定的频率（每小时/每天/每周）自动检查更新。

say.text: 帮我监控 AI 模型发布，每天检查一次，重要更新立刻通知我。
say.note: 会启动设置向导或直接配置监控任务。

say.text: 添加一个安全漏洞监控主题，每小时检查，关键词包括 CVE、critical。
say.note: 通过 manage_topics.py 添加新主题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically monitor topics you specify (e.g., product releases, price changes, news, tech updates), search the web at configurable intervals, score importance with AI, and alert you immediately or via a weekly digest.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request topic monitoring and complete the interactive setup wizard (run setup.py) or manually configure config.json. Claude then checks for updates at your set frequency (hourly/daily/weekly).

say_en.text: Monitor AI model releases daily, alert me immediately on important updates.
say_en.note: Starts setup wizard or configures monitoring.

say_en.text: Add a security vulnerability topic, check hourly, keywords include CVE, critical.
